About this space
Experience true comfort and convenience at Kumalo Mews. Our home features :
- Two spacious bedrooms & two bathrooms with comfortable beds
- A bright lounge with DSTV
- Fully equipped kitchen for self catering stays
- Clean modern bathrooms with hot water
-Backup solar and filtered borehole water
- Unlimited reliable StarLink Wifi
- Ideal location close to Harare Victoria road
-Guests have exclusive use of the entire house and garden
- Flexible check in & checkout
